In the plains under mount Tai lay the Xu province and its weak governor Tao Qian and it's about time for the old codger to get deposed.
The people of Xu province fear that the Yellow Turban remnants will descend from the mountain, pillaging and raiding the anything in their wake. Let's show them who is truly to be feared around.

These decadent, naive warlords bicker over the scraps of the Han - they are all as guilty as one another. This Cao Cao upstart claim he will restore the imperial authority, but he is nothing but a power-hungry fool, deserving of the axe.
The decadent warlords of the Han are a dying breed, and we are their executioners. We should take Xuchang, and impose our control on the central plains from thereon.

Cecuring valuable territory must be our priority. Runan, once a nest of rebels, is known for its prosperity and ripe for the taking.

Unity is a hard-won thing, but it must be claimed - even despite protest. We must, in concert with our allies and vassals, move south-east and defeat those who would stand in the way of peace and harmony.

To the warlord who would be emperor, the southlands present a tempting opportunity. Shouchun is a key location - rich and prosperous yet held by men reaching above their station. Claiming it would establish us as a powerhouse north of the Yangtze.
